title: Omnichannel & Non-Voice Support
summary: Live chat management, email ticketing, social media support and SMS and messaging response handling.
problems: Customers expect answers on the channel they choose
Chat, email and social enquiries are handled in separate silos
Response times vary from one channel to another
delivery: We manage customer conversations across chat, email, social media and messaging, with shared context so customers receive a consistent answer whichever channel they use.
value: One joined-up view of customer contact
